newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police catch 29 Rwandan illegal immigrants.
newsitem.headline: Italian police catch 29 Rwandan illegal immigrants.

text.p: Police said on Thursday they had detained 29 Rwandans on the small Italian island of Pantelleria, between Sicily and Tunisia, after the Africans had entered the country illegally by boat.
Police said the Rwandans were taken to Trapani, on the southern coast of Sicily, where immigration officials would serve them with expulsion orders.
They said the immigrants had been dropped off at the island by a boat which then sped away.
The group was part of a stream of thousands of illegal immigrants who pour into Italy crammed into small boats at great risk and high cost.
The southern Adriatic coast and another remote island between Sicily and North Africa, Lampedusa, are favoured entry points.
Authorities acknowledge that many of illegal immigrants ignore the expulsion notices and stay in Italy or try to move on to other European countries.
